about: Mississauga is a large city immediately west of Toronto, on Lake Ontario in the Greater Toronto Area. It grew from several lakeshore towns into a major suburban municipality with its own downtown at Square One. Toronto Pearson International Airport sits on the city’s northeast edge. About 720,000 people live in Mississauga.
seoSummary: Large GTA city west of Toronto, home to Pearson Airport and Square One.
